exposure: postpartum previous on or two caesarean sections
outcome: incidence of misplaced IUCDs requiring surgery
cohort: 4557 women who received IUCDs at a Tertiary Care Teaching Hospital
finding: The study identified a 1.6% incidence of misplaced IUCDs requiring surgical intervention, with risk factors including postpartum status, prior cesarean sections, low parity, operator experience, and uterocervical length discrepancy.
